Every food and nutrient observation in the complete publisher Fineli Release 20.0 74-component archive. Companion 55-component and raw-ingredient archives retained without double-counting overlapping foods. This downloadable snapshot is not claimed as the current live API.

All recipe component and dietary-flag rows in the complete Fineli Release 20.0 archive. Formula rows grouped by source food ID; source amounts and cooking-factor fields retained without treating them as independently quantified recipes. Diet labels remain source assertions, not verified qualifications.

All FOODfiles 2024 Version 01 food names and all 571,495 unabridged nutrient observations parsed; all 30 installer components retained locally. Canonical facts use whole-food W matrix only; fatty-acid F and nitrogen N matrices remain source-specific. Multiple energy, carbohydrate and fibre definitions remain distinct. Source values unaltered; selected FSANZ available-carbohydrate energy definition explicitly identified. Not the newer 2026 online-search data.

Complete official Swedish full-database workbook export, version 2026-07-01; every food and all 58 nutrient columns parsed without changing source values. Missing values remain unknown. Recipe-derived foods are composition references, not quantified recipe instructions.
All 12 CSV relational tables in the complete CNF 2015 archive. Every food and nutrient observation parsed; original files and supporting guides retained locally.

Every food row and component in the complete main composition table, corrected 27 March 2026. All 17 publisher release files retained; special-denominator companion tables remain original files, outside this per-100g projection. Parenthesized values remain unresolved.

Every row in all 16 pinned place Parquet files examined. All food/drink venues, non-tobacco food/beverage stores, farmers markets and agricultural farm references selected. No confidence or first-N truncation; rows outside the selected taxonomy scope explicitly excluded. Place category, operation and country remain source assertions.
All results of the direct P31 food-manufacturer, supermarket-chain and grocery-store-chain query. Subclass query timed out; direct-type results are not all businesses or complete country registers.
All 100 country options in the FAO directory; reference metadata only, no guideline content copied or diet rules applied. Countries absent from the directory remain unresolved.
All current pages in English Wikibooks Category:Recipes, Cookbook namespace, collected with complete API continuation. A dated retrieval, not a transactionally frozen dump.

publication: See expanded release acceptance; local collection counts here do not mean independently accepted food identity or countrywide completeness.
